## Summary
- Route review syntheses with `Recommended Next Step = HUMAN_DECISION` to `agent-self-approve` when self-approval is enabled, regardless of review verdict.
- Keep orchestration simple: the orchestrator only routes on the structured recommended-next-step signal; the self-approval agent handles the actual approve/request-changes/blocked decision.
- Preserve approval safety: non-`SHIP` HUMAN_DECISION can run the decision gate only when the latest trusted current-head synthesis also recommends `HUMAN_DECISION`, and actual GitHub approval still requires trusted current-head `SHIP` provenance.
- Thread only structured source verdict/recommended-step inputs through the workflows/prompts and update focused docs/tests.

## Verification
- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `npm --prefix .agent test`
- `git diff --check`

Alternative clean implementation for #262 / #264 / #265 and issue #263.

@sepo-agent /answer when self approval decides request changes, would orchestrator dispatch to the corresponding route?

Yes. On current PR head, if `agent-self-approve` returns `REQUEST_CHANGES`/`changes_requested`, the orchestrator maps that to `fix-pr`.

Flow:

- `agent-self-approve.yml` runs the handoff step with `SOURCE_ACTION=agent-self-approve`, `SOURCE_CONCLUSION`, and `SOURCE_HANDOFF_CONTEXT`: [workflow lines](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/c6aea1475ab62e459b9455fde45d8b25762b9ba0/.github/workflows/agent-self-approve.yml#L207-L230)
- `handoff.ts` maps self-approval `request_changes` / `changes_requested` to `nextAction: "fix-pr"` and preserves the handoff context: [handoff lines](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/c6aea1475ab62e459b9455fde45d8b25762b9ba0/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L516-L525)
- The dispatcher then invokes `agent-fix-pr.yml` with that context as `orchestrator_context`: [dispatch lines](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/c6aea1475ab62e459b9455fde45d8b25762b9ba0/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L1574-L1580)

Caveats: this only happens when orchestration is enabled, the round budget is not exhausted, and the handoff is not deduped by an existing marker. Otherwise it stops visibly instead of dispatching.
